# Science [color=#c96dbf]Science[/color] generates [color=#a4885c]Research Points[/color] by fighting - not by sitting at a console - and spends them unlocking new gear across several specialized research branches, including a line of heavy weapons anyone on the station can buy once researched.
## Personnel [color=#c96dbf]Science[/color]'s staff is made up of Research Assistants and Scientists. [color=#c96dbf]Science[/color] is run by the Research Director.
## The Harvester
Buy the [color=#a4885c]Harvester[/color] from the Science shop and hold the beam on wave enemies. Every hit generates [color=#a4885c]Research Points[/color] for the station - this is the only source of Research Points during combat, so being out in the field with this weapon out is the actual job, not a detour from it.
At the R&D console you can pick your own research target - your hits fund it directly, at full cost - or leave nothing selected and your hits go toward whichever node the Research Director has chosen instead (a [color=green]discounted, half-cost[/color] shared pick). If someone else is already personally researching a node you're interested in, you can join them and pool your contributions together - look for the small count badge on a node in the tree.
Swapping to a different weapon and back is free and instant - your research progress is never lost, so there's no penalty to putting the Harvester down for a fight and picking it back up later.
## The Research Console
The R&D console shows six colored tabs, one per research branch. Each branch is its own independent tree of nodes - unlocking one node in [color=#F97316]Ordnance[/color] has nothing to do with progress in [color=#3B82F6]Medical[/color] or [color=#F59E0B]Engineering[/color]. Any Scientist can select a node to personally research; the Research Director or Captain can instead lock in the station's shared, discounted pick.
## Ordnance
[color=#F97316]Ordnance[/color] is the weapons branch, and the one reason to main Science even if you never touch a lathe: researching far enough down a weapon line unlocks its shop - the L6-SAW, Minigun, Hydra grenade launcher, RPG-7, X-Ray Cannon, and Tesla Cannon. Anyone on the station can buy from an unlocked shop, so Science's payoff is being the one who makes it possible in the first place. The Harvester itself also has its own small research line inside Ordnance, so time spent researching makes your own weapon stronger too, not just everyone else's.
## Medical, Logistics, Engineering, Research The other four branches wrap the station's Medical, Service, Salvage/Engineering, and general Research disciplines - unlocking a node there prints new recipes at the relevant lathes (medical gear, cargo/service equipment, engineering machinery, and so on) rather than granting a combat buff.
## Deployables
Two more Science-exclusive tools: the Null Field slows enemies in an area, the Damage Beacon amplifies damage dealt to enemies in an area. Both regenerate one charge per wave and can be upgraded for an extra charge at the shop.
## Lathes
At a lathe, you can choose a server to allow it print whatever recipes you have unlocked. Recipes require various materials (steel, glass, plastic, gold, plasma) which can be acquired at Cargo or Salvage.
